subject: Capacity uplift request — hosted commit increase & soft-throttle transition
messages:
From: Elena Rossi <elena@lumaretail.com>
To: Priyom Das <priyom_das@redwood.ai>
Date: 2026-05-21T09:12:05-07:00
Subject: Capacity uplift and rate band question

Hi Priyom,

We're looking at a steep seasonal spike in Q3 and we'd like to increase our hosted monthly commit from 200M tokens to 320M tokens (roughly +60%). Two quick asks: 
- What pricing tiers would apply for 320M? Can we keep the current per-token rates for the first 2 months while we ramp?
- Do you support a "soft throttle" transition window so traffic degrades gracefully if we spike past commit during the ramp?

If you can send a draft amendment and a migration plan, procurement will review it this week.

Thanks,
Elena Rossi
Head of Platform
LumaRetail

attachments: none

From: Priyom Das <priyom_das@redwood.ai>
To: Elena Rossi <elena@lumaretail.com>
Cc: Lauren Bishop <lauren_bishop@redwood.ai>
Date: 2026-05-21T10:00:12-07:00
Subject: Re: Capacity uplift and rate band question

Elena — thanks for the note. Great to hear Q3 is looking strong. Quick summary / proposal below and I attached a draft SOW and pricing breakdown for procurement: Lumaretail_draft_SOW_v2.pdf, pricing_breakdown_Q3.xlsx.

Proposal (high level):
- Commit: increase hosted monthly commit from 200M -> 320M tokens starting July 1, 2026.
- Pricing: Offer current per-token rate at the 200M tier for the first 60 days post-change (grace period) so you avoid immediate step pricing while you ramp. After 60 days, normal 320M-tier unit pricing applies.
- Discount: 6% term discount on the incremental uplift (applied across months 1–12 of the amendment).
- Soft-throttle window: We will enable a 14-day soft-throttle transition window on the commit change. During that window:
  * Requests above commit will be rate-limited with a degrade-first policy (latency-first fallback to 2nd-tier model variant).
  * Prefix KV caching and conservative batching will be applied to reduce spiky token usage.
- Rollout plan: staged cutover (weekend maintenance + traffic mirroring for 48 hours) to validate behavior.

Next steps: let me know if procurement needs alternate terms (net-45 vs net-30), and I can send a DocuSign amendment once we agree. Are you available for a 30-min sync today at 3pm PT?

Thanks,
Priyom Das
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
Phone: (415) 555-0123
